title: Station Eleven
author: Emily St. John Mandel
summary: A flu wipes out most of humanity, and a travelling troupe of actors and musicians keeps performing in the ruins. The story moves between the collapse and the years before it, linking a handful of lives.
readIf: You want an end-of-the-world story that is more about art and connection than survival tactics.
skipIf: A story about a deadly pandemic is too close to home right now.

pairings.reason: A shorter, stranger book with the same dreamlike quality and attention to small details.
A far more upbeat take on humanity facing disaster, with a lot more humour.
